package.name: ibvs_perception
package.description: Cube detection for IBVS. Single perception node (separation of concerns): HSV red segmentation, minAreaRect corner extraction, temporal corner matching (D4 group), PnP depth (ViSP DEMENTHON + VIRTUAL_VS), aligned depth-image sampling, and CameraInfo intrinsics. Publishes ibvs_msgs/FeatureTarget consumed by all controllers.
